chunks: When he fled on the laden ship,
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Jonah fleeing on the laden ship?
ai.summary: This verse segment from Surah As-Saffat highlights the Prophet Jonah (Yunus) fleeing onto a heavily loaded ship, an event that precedes his casting into the sea during the great storm. In Shia exegesis, this moment is often viewed as a consequence of his premature departure before receiving explicit divine permission, illustrating the tension between prophetic duty and human impatience. The 'loaded' nature of the ship underscores the magnitude of the trial he faced as he was separated from his community.
